newsitem.title: UK: Sedgewick to advise Azeri state oil SOCAR.
newsitem.headline: Sedgewick to advise Azeri state oil SOCAR.

text.p: Sedgewick Europe Risk Services is to provide risk management advice and insurance broking services to Azerbaijan's state oil company SOCAR, the insurance broker said in a statement.

"Sedgewick Azeri Ltd, a subsidiary of Sedgewick Group which opened for business in Baku earlier this year, has announced the signing of an agreement with the state oil company, SOCAR," the statement said.

Under the agreement, the company will provide risk management advice and insurance broking services to SOCAR and its affiliated companies in the operation and development of its upstream and downstream facilities.
SOCAR, which represents Azeri state interests in the exploitation of the Azeri oil fields, has stakes in a number of exploration and development joint projects in the Caspian Sea.
Sedgewick Europe Risk Services is a wholly-owned subsidiary of insurance group Sedgewick Group.
